items.question: What is knowledge perceived by the mind called?
premises: the verse gives a four-token definition
items.inference: knowledge perceived by mind is called brahman
uncertainties: exact case role of mātrasamvedyaṃ depends on syntax
items.plain_english: Knowledge perceived by the mind is called brahman.

items.question: Who is called a knower of yoga?
premises: such a yogin is called yoga-knower
items.inference: a yogin who knows the one abode is called a yoga-knower
uncertainties: compound internal members are not split
items.plain_english: The yogin who knows the one abode is called a knower of yoga.

rows.grounds: compound noun in nominative or accusative

items.question: What meditation is called samadhi?
premises: meditation empty of own form is named samadhi
the verse defines samadhi by emptiness
items.inference: meditation empty of own form is called samadhi
uncertainties: case of taddhyānaṃ is not fully fixed
items.plain_english: Meditation empty of its own form is called samadhi.

items.question: What happens when truth is self-manifested?
premises: one becomes identified with it instantly
items.inference: when truth is self-manifested one becomes identified with it in that instant
uncertainties: prakāśite may modify tattve rather than stand alone
items.plain_english: When truth is self-manifested, one becomes identified with it in that instant.

items.question: Who is certainly liberated without breath?
premises: one without inhalation and exhalation is certainly liberated
the verse asserts this with eva
items.inference: one without inhalation and exhalation is certainly liberated
uncertainties: mukta may be adjectival or participial
items.plain_english: One without inhalation and exhalation is certainly liberated.

items.question: Who is called living-liberated while sitting like dead?
premises: one who sits like dead is called living-liberated
the verse names this state jīvanmukta
items.inference: one who sits like dead is called living-liberated
uncertainties: mṛtavatsākṣāt may be adverbial or adjectival
items.plain_english: One who sits like dead is called living-liberated.
